WITH player_counts AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS award_count
    FROM manager_award
    GROUP BY player_id
), total AS (
    SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total_count
    FROM player_counts
)
SELECT pc.player_id,
       pc.award_count,
       CAST(pc.award_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.total_count, 0) AS fraction
FROM player_counts AS pc
CROSS JOIN total AS t
WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
